intro.speaker: aya
intro.text: I read the study with you. It's short — three ideas, and we'll test each one.

L1U1.speaker: aya
L1U1.text: Two groups, two test times. Keep an eye on the timing.

sourceRefs.quote: Five minutes later the re-reading group did slightly better.

L1U2.speaker: aya
L1U2.text: The paper splits study activities into two kinds.

sourceRefs.quote: Retrieval practice means pulling information out of memory

L1U3.speaker: aya
L1U3.text: Now use it: Lin has a week, and twenty minutes on the metro.

outro.speaker: aya
outro.text: Three ideas done. Remember the twist: re-reading looks better at first, recall wins later.
